name: Salt (Crystal Mineral Detail)
description: High-detail 3D showcase of pure crystal sea salt. A sharp geometric pyramid of glistening white mineral salt crystals resting inside a dark black cedar measuring box with crimson lacquered corners and a polished dark scoop, bathed in dramatic crimson red rim lighting.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of crystalline sea salt. A sharp pyramid of glistening translucent white salt crystal minerals in an antique black cedar masu measuring box with bright crimson red lacquered edges, dark metal measuring scoop. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), intense crimson red (#FF2035) rim lighting reflecting on crystal facets, dramatic contrast, 8k render, no text.
